scripts.dev: composer dump-autoload && php artisan optimize:clear && concurrently 'vite' 'npm run https-proxy' 'php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8001'
scripts.push: git checkout master && git merge develop --no-ff -m "Merge branch 'develop'" && git push && git checkout develop
scripts.pull: git pull && composer install && npm ci && npm run build && sudo php artisan optimize:clear
